scheme_name: Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Setting-up of Specialized Skill Development Centers at Industry
other_conditions: Industry partner must be an industry or association with at least 10 years of experience in skill development
Both the industry partner and the training centre must be legally registered under the Societies Act, Trust Act, or Companies Act
Courses offered must be aligned with NSDC, NCVT, GCVT, or Sector Skill Council guidelines
At least 25% of the course intake must be industry‑sponsored
A minimum of 75% of industry‑sponsored trainees must be provided employment
The training centre must have been operational for at least 5 years
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to 50% of project cost (maximum ₹2 crore) for setting up or refurbishing the training centre, plus up to ₹1 lakh per centre per year for awareness programmes and seminars.
